note: Defects and remarks that exist only in the unmerged candidate, or were noticed while re-testing it. Kept out of the main findings register.

findings.title: The kept-aside notice cannot be dismissed and a kept-aside note cannot be removed, so the bar at the top of the Japji reader is permanent
findings.location: js/japji-full.js: updateRecoveryNotice() shows the notice whenever any item is kept aside; retainedMarkup() offers read-only text and no removal; js/learning.js: the archive is only ever merged into.
findings.evidence: The notice is 62 to 81 pixels tall (9 to 14 per cent of the screen height) in 36 of 36 measured combinations; its only control is "View saved learning"; it is still shown after viewing and after reopening. The Saved learning screen has no control that removes or clears a kept-aside item. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-002/evidence/cir09_notice_extras.json; reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-002/evidence/rt1_01_cir08_damaged_records_and_export.json (part D).
findings.why_it_matters: One stray note from an older edition costs the reader a tenth of the screen for good. And a note a person wants gone cannot be deleted from inside the app; on a shared device others can read it.
findings.proposed_correction: Let the reader put the notice away once the items have been viewed, and bring it back only when something new is kept aside. Allow a kept-aside item to be removed after offering export, with a plain confirmation.
findings.acceptance_test: After viewing the items the reader can hide the notice and it stays hidden across reopening until a new item is kept aside; a kept-aside item can be removed, and is then absent from every stored record and from the next export.

findings.title: The import asks to merge without saying what the file holds
findings.evidence: "Merge this learning backup? Existing bookmarks are kept and conflicting reflections are retained together." — no counts. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-002/evidence/rt1_01_older_copy_all_storage.json (step 6).
findings.why_it_matters: A person cannot tell a full backup from an empty or wrong file before merging it.
findings.proposed_correction: Say how many notes, saved lines and kept-aside items the file holds before merging.
findings.acceptance_test: The preview names the three counts and they match the file.

findings.title: A listed note is two taps away from being read, and the list does not show its first words
findings.location: js/japji-full.js: learning() — list items carry data-action="jump".
findings.evidence: Tapping "Pauri 20 · line 1 … Reflection" moves the reader to Pauri 20 · line 1 and closes the panel; the note is not on screen. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-002/evidence/ciu11_saved_list_extras.json.
findings.why_it_matters: The point of the list is to read reflections back. This is the part of the CI-U-11 acceptance test that is not met.
findings.proposed_correction: Show the first words of the note in the list; open the note when its line is tapped.
findings.acceptance_test: Tapping a listed reflection shows the reflection.

findings.title: When the browser cannot store, the reader says the saved learning "needs recovery"
findings.evidence: With every write refused and both records good, the notice reads "Saved learning needs recovery. Export the original backup." Nothing is damaged. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-002/evidence/rt1_01_cir08_damaged_records_and_export.json (part C).
findings.why_it_matters: It sends the person looking for damage that is not there.
findings.proposed_correction: "This browser could not save. Your earlier notes are unchanged. Export a backup."
findings.acceptance_test: With writes refused and good records the message says saving failed, not that the records are damaged.

findings.title: On a refusal screen each reader exports only its own notes, and does not say so
findings.location: js/japji-full.js: exportOriginalLearning(); js/sukhmani-reader.js: the failure-screen export.
findings.evidence: The Japji file holds the Japji record and the kept-aside archive, not the Sukhmani note; the Sukhmani file holds only the Sukhmani record. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-002/evidence/cir08_refusal_screen_export.json.
findings.why_it_matters: The screen says "Export your learning"; a person with notes in two readers will believe one file has them all.
findings.proposed_correction: Name which notes the file holds, or export all three stores in one file.
findings.acceptance_test: The refusal screen says which notes are in the file, or the file holds every stored learning record.

findings.title: An emptied note leaves an empty entry in the stored record
findings.evidence: After the text is cleared the line leaves the list but its key stays in notes with an empty value. reviews/claude-independent/retests/RT-002/evidence/ciu11_saved_list_extras.json (part e).
findings.proposed_correction: Delete the entry when the text is empty.
findings.acceptance_test: After a note is emptied its line is absent from the stored notes.

findings.title: Before this is made public: the ten-minute check on a real iPhone, on a labelled build whose banner does not cover the reader
